gripOrHq.title: Minotaur
gripOrHq.rulesText: For each rezzed code gate or wall installed outside Minotaur, Minotaur has one "*End the run" subroutine.

gripOrHq.title: Data Fort Reclamation
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gain [10] and choose up to four cards stored in HQ when you score Data Fort Reclamation. Create a new data fort using the cards chosen. Install the cards one at a time; you may rez them when you install them. Then, return to the bank any of the [10] not spent.

gripOrHq.title: Tokyo-Chiba Infighting
gripOrHq.rulesText:
Gain [2] after each unsuccessful run on this fort.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

gripOrHq.title: Corporate War
gripOrHq.rulesText: If you have [12] or more bits in your pool when you score Corporate War, gain [12]; otherwise, lose all bits.

gripOrHq.title: Washed-Up Solo Construct
gripOrHq.rulesText: *Trash a program unless Runner pays [1]. Gain [3] when you rez Washed-Up Solo Construct.

gripOrHq.title: Edgerunner, Inc., Temps
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gain three consecutive actions, which you may use only to install cards. You are not required to take all three of these actions.

heapOrArchives.title: Red Herrings
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Runner must pay [5], in addition to any other costs, to steal agendas accessed from this fort, even on the run during which Runner trashes Red Herrings.

heapOrArchives.title: Olivia Salazar
heapOrArchives.rulesText: For half cost, rounded down, rez a piece of ice installed on this fort. Derez that ice at the end of the run. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

discardCards.title: Inside Job
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

discardCards.title: All-Nighter
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run; whether or not that run is successful, you may then make another run.

scoreArea.title: Corporate War
scoreArea.rulesText: If you have [12] or more bits in your pool when you score Corporate War, gain [12]; otherwise, lose all bits.

rig.title: Zetatech Software Installer
rig.rulesText: Put [2] bits on Software Installer when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for installing programs. You may use these bits to install a program overwriting Software Installer itself. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: R&D Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

rig.title: Rigged Investments
rig.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Rigged Investments when it is installed. At the start of each of your turns, take [1] from Rigged Investments. When all the bits have been removed, trash Rigged Investments.

rig.title: Short-Term Contract
rig.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

rig.title: Silicon Saloon Franchise
rig.rulesText: A: Gain [1] and draw one card.

ice.title: Mastermind
ice.rulesText: *Do 1 brain damage for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside Mastermind. *End the run. Mastermind has +1 strength for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside it.

root.title: Tesseract Fort Construction
root.rulesText: All ice on this fort has an additional subroutine, "*End the run unless Runner pays [1]," after all other subroutines.
